source.project: KS — 40K Army Builder and Combat Lab
source.notice: Community data snapshot. Numeric profiles are used for a personal game prototype and are not tournament certification.

greyKnights.notice: Additional Grey Knights use the smallest listed unit and first-unit points. Rectangular footprints and stock are game adaptations. Existing combat profiles are preserved; datasheet reference profiles may differ. One chosen weapon resolves in automatic combat; other weapons and ability names are reference information.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Sanctifying Ritual: secured objectives remain yours until enemy control exceeds yours.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Indomitable Spirit: may shoot and charge after advancing or falling back.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Sanctic Hood: the led squad ignores Psychic wounds on 4+. Haloed in Soulfire: enemies must be within 18 inches to shoot the led squad.
datasheet.composition: 1 Brotherhood Librarian This model is equipped with: Nemesis force weapon; Vortex of Doom.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Personal Teleporters: after shooting, an unengaged squad may move up to 6 inches, giving up its charge that turn.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Attuned Onslaught: charging Paladins gain 1 melee damage for that turn.
datasheet.composition: 1 Paragon 3-9 Paladins Every model is equipped with: storm bolter; Nemesis force weapon.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Righteous Persecution: shooting can pin one hit target other than Monsters and Vehicles, reducing movement and charge distance by 2 until your next turn.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Champion of the Order of Purifiers: grants the led squad an extra Purifying Flame attack per model. Foresight: reroll hits when attacking Characters.
datasheet.composition: 1 Castellan Crowe – EPIC HERO This model is equipped with: Purifying Flame; storm bolter; Black Blade of Antwyr.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Sanctuary: the squad gains Stealth and enemies suffer −1 to hit it in melee. Hammer Aflame: a fight-phase roll inflicts mortal wounds on an engaged enemy.
datasheet.composition: 1 Grand Master Voldus – EPIC HERO This model is equipped with: Searing Purity; storm bolter; Malleus Argyrum.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Clarion of Haste: the led squad can charge after advancing. Inspiring Exemplar: defeating a Character in melee awards CP and improves the Champion’s attacks.
datasheet.composition: 1 Brotherhood Champion This model is equipped with: storm bolter; Nemesis force weapon.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Zealous Path: the led squad rerolls charges. Litanies of Sanctity: once per battle, removes Battle-shock from a nearby Grey Knights squad.
datasheet.composition: 1 Brotherhood Chaplain This model is equipped with: storm bolter; crozius arcanum.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Techmarine: gains Lone Operative near friendly vehicles. Blessing of the Omnissiah: repairs a nearby vehicle and improves its hits. Guardians of the Machine: discounts a qualifying Heroic Intervention.
datasheet.composition: 1 Brotherhood Techmarine This model is equipped with: forge bolter; grav-pistol; Omnissian power axe; servo-arm.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Hammerhand: grants Lethal Hits to the led squad’s melee weapons. Eye of Judgement: rerolls this model’s wounds.
datasheet.composition: 1 Brother-Captain This model is equipped with: storm bolter; Nemesis force weapon.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Guidance of the Ancients: a target hit by this model’s shooting becomes easier for other Grey Knights to hit for the rest of that phase.
datasheet.composition: 1 Venerable Dreadnought This model is equipped with: assault cannon; storm bolter; Dreadnought combat weapon.

datasheet.abilitySummary: Untouchable Purity: the led squad ignores mortal wounds on 4+. One With the Warp: once per battle, gains 3 to a charge after arriving by teleport. Supreme Commander: must be the Warlord when included.
